guarantees.claim: When we_i[0] is high, at the next posedge clk_i, the concatenated output {a_y1_q, a_y0_q, b_y1_q, b_y0_q} is updated with the current input concatenation {a_y1, a_y0, b_y1, b_y0}; when low, the output holds its previous value.
After reset (rst_ni low), the outputs are cleared to 0 due to ResetValue='0, regardless of we_i[0] or input values.

assumptions.claim: we_i[0] must be asserted only when valid data is presented on a_y1, a_y0, b_y1, b_y0, and should remain high for exactly one cycle per intended update to prevent multiple unintended captures.
assumptions.cond: when we_i[0] is used to load data
assumptions.risk: If we_i[0] is held high for multiple cycles, the outputs may capture subsequent input changes, potentially propagating stale or uninitialized values.

assumptions.claim: we_i[0] must be glitch-free and combinatorial paths from the registered outputs to we_i[0] must be avoided to prevent hold-time violations.
assumptions.risk: Glitches on we_i[0] or timing loops could cause metastability or unintended latch-up behavior.
